# Sayyad Adeel Ahmad

> Personal portfolio of Sayyad Adeel Ahmad — a student who learns by building.
> Projects, experiments, notes and the process that connects them. Everything
> here is his own work; there is no agency and no client list behind it.

A three-route site. The homepage is the whole portfolio; the other two are the
contact page and a not-found page.

## Projects

- [Selected work](https://adeelsayyad.tech/#featured-work): Donut Website, an
  E-commerce Website, and AgentOS — described in his own words, with what each
  one was for and what he got wrong.
- [How I turn ideas into projects](https://adeelsayyad.tech/#process): curiosity,
  research, build, experiment, refine, learn.

## Notes

- [Notes from the rabbit hole](https://adeelsayyad.tech/#notes): short
  first-person write-ups from building things. Currently two — why he keeps
  building things he does not fully understand, and what building with almost no
  budget taught him.
- [Things I keep learning](https://adeelsawyad.tech/#github): the working notes
  behind the projects.

## Contact

- [Contact](https://adeelsayyad.tech/contact): a form that emails him, plus his
  GitHub handle and email address.
- Email: contact@adeelsayyad.tech

## Notes for automated readers

- Content is server-rendered. The text in this file is also present in the HTML
  of each page; nothing here needs JavaScript to read.
- Previous URLs from an earlier version of this site are answered: `/about`,
  `/pricing`, `/case-studies` and `/blogs` redirect to the homepage sections that
  now carry that content. Other retired URLs return 410 Gone.
